_comment: Baseline for check-address-reachability.mjs, keyed check -> "state|district_type" -> count. The gate fires on GROWTH in a bucket or on ANY new bucket. Shrink these numbers as the backlog is worked off; never raise one without saying why in the commit message. 2026-08-19: DEAD_GEOGRAPHY in|JUDICIAL (was 2) REMOVED, not lowered - those were the Kirsch D2 and Riley D4 Court of Appeals seats, whose holders had retired with no successor recorded. Migration 1835 seated Kenworthy and DeBoer, so the bucket is empty and any reappearance should fire as a NEW bucket. 2026-08-28: DEAD_GEOGRAPHY fl|NATIONAL_LOWER (was 1) REMOVED, not lowered - the entry was STALE, not fixed by that day's Knight FL work. Verified: all 28 FL NATIONAL_LOWER districts carry both a G5200 and a G5200V26 polygon and match ONLY G52* mtfccs, so the earlier congressional load (SL 2025-95 / G5200V26) had already resolved it and nobody shrank the baseline. Checked for the obvious trap first - a 5-char sldl/sldu or 7-char place geo_id colliding with a congressional one - and FL congressional geo_ids are 4 chars, so no collision is possible. 2026-09-23 (CA_0189): SHRUNK, nothing raised. UNREACHABLE ca|LOCAL 19 -> 6 (remaining: Whittier council D1-4, Orange County supervisor D1/D4) and BAD_GEOMETRY ca|LOCAL (was 1) REMOVED - both measured on prod after the council-district geofence loads since the last baseline (Monterey Park 2026-08-31, LA County RR/CC 2026 precinct boundaries 2026-09-22/23), not by CA_0189. UNREACHABLE dc|SCHOOL_BOARD (was 1) REMOVED - migration 1852 reclassified DC board seats to STATE_BOARD_EDUCATION, so no DC SCHOOL_BOARD district exists. CA_0189 itself linked the CA courts (Supreme Court 06, held LA Superior Court seats 06037, 2nd Appellate District X0029), so the ca|JUDICIAL 421 that CA_0183 produced is 0 and is NOT baselined; 81 unheld per-judge slots stay geo_id NULL and fall in no bucket. 2026-09-24 (CA_0199): MOVED, not raised - UNREACHABLE total stays 24. The two Orange County supervisor seats (D1/D4, OCD geo_ids ocd-division/country:us/state:ca/county:orange/council_district:N with no geofence) were retyped LOCAL -> COUNTY with the other 57 sub-county districts, so ca|LOCAL 6 -> 4 (Whittier council D1-4) and NEW bucket ca|COUNTY 2. They were unreachable before and after; the fix is geography for that board, not a type.
